title: Techniques in Raku With Jesus Fernandez – Thursday Evenings
source_quote:
Techniques in Raku With Jesus Fernandez – Thursday Evenings
Explore Three Techniques in Raku in a fun 4 week class for advancing students. Oct 8 – 29 (Thu) / 6 pm – 8:30 pm / $250
evidence_sentence: The Techniques in Raku class explicitly teaches raku firing techniques including horsehair raku, golden crackle, and naked raku with live firing.
evidence_quote: It's a Raku Class! We're going to light things on fire!
summary: A 4-week raku class teaching horsehair raku, golden crackle, and naked raku techniques with live firing, for advancing students. Runs Oct 8–29, 2026.
